::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/organization/model_prices"}
#docs
The list price per model and token type at `as_of` (default now), with your cost in effect at the same instant.

## Query parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `provider` | `string` | no | Only this provider, for example `openai`. |
| `model` | `string` | no | Only this model id. |
| `token_type` | `string` | no | Only this token type, for example `input`. |
| `q` | `string` | no | Text in the model or provider id. |
| `has_cost` | `boolean` | no | Only rows with your cost. |
| `used` | `boolean` | no | Only models your meters saw in the last 35 days. |
| `business` | `string` | no | Only models this business (biz_…) used in the last 35 days. Implies `used`. |
| `as_of` | `string · ISO-8601` | no | Prices at this instant. |
| `limit` | `integer` | no | Page size, 1–500 (default 100). |
| `starting_after` | `string` | no | Cursor: the last row's `id` from the previous page. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `list`. One of `list`. |
| `data` | `array of object` | The rows on this page. |
| `data.object` | `string` | The object type; always `model_price`. One of `model_price`. |
| `data.id` | `string` | The model price's id. |
| `data.provider` | `string` | The payment provider. |
| `data.model` | `string` | The pricing model. |
| `data.token_type` | `string` | `input`, `output`, `cache_read`, `cache_write`, … as the source names them. |
| `data.currency` | `string` | The model price's currency (ISO-4217 code). |
| `data.unit_amount_decimal` | `string` | Minor units (cents for USD) per `quantity_divisor` units. A decimal string with at most 12 decimal places and no exponent, for example `"0.25"`. |
| `data.quantity_divisor` | `integer` | 1,000,000 for tokens; 1,000 for counted items such as web searches. |
| `data.effective_from` | `string · ISO-8601` | The instant we apply this price from. Null = the model's first price. |
| `data.source_effective_from` | `string` | The source's own date for this price. |
| `data.source` | `string` | Where the model price comes from. |
| `data.source_version` | `string` | The model price's source version. |
| `data.rounded` | `boolean` | The source value had more than 12 decimal places in cents: rounded half-up once. |
| `data.last_seen_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the source last listed this model. |
| `data.cost` | `object` | The model price list row's cost. |
| `data.used` | `boolean` | The model price list row's used. |
| `has_more` | `boolean` | Whether more rows exist after this page. |
| `next_cursor` | `string` | Pass as `starting_after` to get the next page. Null on the last page. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | One page of list prices. |
| `400` | A parameter is not correct. |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/organization/model_prices?limit=10" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY"
```
